_comment: Tasks that must be alive in every healthy device run. The stack-watermark budget can only judge tasks that appear in the snapshot, so a task that crashed or never launched would otherwise pass silently -- with maximal apparent headroom. Absence of any task listed here fails the run. Curated deliberately (NOT generated from a snapshot like stack_watermark_budget.json): only tasks whose absence is unambiguously a fault belong here. Tasks that exist conditionally -- ha_ws_push (needs a Home Assistant config), mdns, telemetry_histo, and transient workers such as history_query and ota_task -- are intentionally excluded so they cannot red an otherwise-healthy run.
